sig: [[["A", "This is an important safety announcement from VoltEdge Electronics."], ["A", "We are recalling our PowerQuick sixty-five watt laptop charger, model number PQ-65."], ["A", "The recall covers chargers sold between March and August of this year."], ["A", "We have found that some of these chargers can overheat and, in rare cases, cause burns."], ["A", "So far, we have received eight reports of overheating, but no serious injuries."], ["A", "If you own one of these chargers, please stop using it immediately and unplug it."], ["A", "You can check your model number on the back of the charger."], ["A", "To get a free replacement, visit our website at voltedge dot com slash recall, or call our customer service line."], ["A", "You don't need a receipt."], ["A", "Replacement chargers will be shipped within ten business days."], ["A", "We are very sorry for the inconvenience, and we thank you for your understanding."]], {"A": "F-US"}]
